It's easy to justify our own choices and convince ourselves we're on the right track — we all do it. But what a gift it is to serve a God who sees past our rationalizations and looks straight at the heart. This verse is not a warning to fear, but an invitation to honesty. You don't have to perform or pretend before God. Come to Him openly, ask Him to search your heart, and trust that His gentle correction always leads to something better than the path you were on.
